levels.help:
Balls to the walls: Hit the disk on the scoreboard.
If it lands on the table, you have to push it off the edge
to get points.
Some ghost blocks. 3 minutes to clear the toys.

Put the ball in the dip to turn the piece white to
get bonus points when you push it off the edge
Spikey balls are a bit of a challenge to get over the edge.
Put the ball in the lifesaver to earn bonus points.
